title: Schema Types
description: Master the GraphQL type system: objects, interfaces, unions, enums, inputs, and scalars.
longDescription: The schema is the contract between your API and its clients. This module teaches you how to define types using Hot Chocolate's code-first approach, including object types, interfaces, unions, enums, input types, and custom scalars.
whatYouLearn: How to define object types, interfaces, and unions
How to create input types for mutations
How to use and extend GraphQL scalars
